content: We made 589 tag conversions over 14 different categories. The breakdown of tag conversions per category is given by table TABREF7. These rules can be further seen in the corresponding Github repository BIBREF12. The modified training and development datasets are also available on another Github repositorypage BIBREF13 for further research and comparison purposes.
